beats.vo: Hey champ, welcome back! It's so nice to see you again.
beats.caption: Welcome back, champ!

beats.vo: Last time, we learned that some pictures are made by AI. So when you see something surprising, you pause, and you ask a grown-up.
beats.caption: Last time: pause, then ask a grown-up

beats.vo: Today is chapter four of Being Smart and Safe With AI. It's called, AI Helping Doctors, Scientists, and Artists.
beats.caption: Chapter 4 · AI Helping Doctors, Scientists, Artists

beats.vo: We've talked a lot about being careful with AI. But here's a happy question. How can AI actually help people?
beats.caption: How can AI actually help people?

beats.vo: Meet Meera. She's in class four, and she loves spending Sundays with her nani.
beats.caption: Meet Meera and her nani

beats.vo: One Sunday, a letter arrives from Meera's cousin. But nani's eyes aren't so strong anymore. The letters look tiny and blurry to her.
beats.caption: Nani can't read the tiny letters

beats.vo: Meera is at school all week. So how could nani read her letters on her own? Think about it.
beats.caption: How could nani read on her own? Think!

beats.vo: Here's one way. Nani points her phone at the page, and a read-aloud app reads every word out loud! Dear Nani, I miss you. Nani smiles. Yay!
beats.caption: A read-aloud app reads it out loud!

beats.vo: That app is an AI helper. And here's the big idea for today. AI is a tool.
beats.caption: Big idea: AI is a TOOL

beats.vo: A tool is something that helps people do a job. Like a pencil helps you write, and a map helps you find the way.
beats.caption: A tool helps people do a job

beats.vo: Remember, AI isn't magic, and it isn't alive. It learned patterns from lots and lots of examples. That's how it knows what letters look like.
beats.caption: Not magic, not alive: it learned patterns

beats.vo: AI helpers are all around us. Let's see three of them.
beats.caption: Three everyday AI helpers

beats.vo: In the park, Meera finds a leaf she doesn't know. What is it? She takes a photo, and a plant spotter app says, this is a neem leaf! It matched the leaf's shape and pattern with thousands of leaf photos.
beats.caption: Plant spotter: photo of a leaf → its name

beats.vo: The read-aloud app helps people who can't see well, just like nani.
beats.caption: Read-aloud: helps people who can't see well

beats.vo: And next Sunday, the maps app finds a good route to nani's house. It even warns, heavy traffic ahead, try this road instead!
beats.caption: Maps: finds a good route, warns about traffic

beats.vo: Now, let's visit a hospital. Have you heard of an X-ray? It's a special photo that shows the bones inside your body.
beats.caption: X-ray: a special photo of your bones

beats.vo: AI has looked at thousands of X-rays. So it can point to a spot and say, doctor, please check this part. That's really useful, because doctors are very busy, and a tiny spot is easy to miss.
beats.caption: AI points out spots for the doctor to check

beats.vo: But who decides what's really wrong, and what medicine to give? The doctor! AI points things out. The doctor checks, and decides.
beats.caption: AI points it out. The doctor decides.

beats.vo: Scientists use AI too. In a forest, they hide cameras on trees. The cameras click thousands and thousands of photos.
beats.caption: Forest cameras click thousands of photos

beats.vo: Counting animals in all those photos would take people weeks! But AI can look through them very quickly, and spot the patterns, like stripes, spots, and long trunks. Tiger, deer, deer, elephant! And it never gets tired.
beats.caption: AI looks fast and counts the animals

beats.vo: AI can also spot weather patterns, like clouds that often come before a big storm. Then scientists check the work, and warn everyone in time.
beats.caption: AI spots storm patterns. Scientists check.

beats.vo: And what about artists? Meera's art teacher, Ritu ma'am, loves painting peacocks.
beats.caption: Meet Ritu ma'am, the art teacher

beats.vo: Sometimes she uses AI like a new brush, to quickly try ideas. A blue peacock? A golden one? Then she picks her favourite, and paints it her own way.
beats.caption: AI is a new brush to try ideas

beats.vo: The ideas, and the imagination, still come from the artist. And copying someone else's drawing isn't fair, even with AI.
beats.caption: Imagination leads. Copying isn't fair.

beats.vo: Now here's the most important part. AI can make mistakes.
beats.caption: AI can make mistakes

beats.vo: Once, Meera's plant app called a tulsi leaf a mint leaf! Oops. That's why people must always check AI's work.
beats.caption: People must check AI's work

beats.vo: So think of AI as a helper on the team, not the boss. A doctor decides your medicine, not an app alone. People stay in charge of the important choices.
beats.caption: AI is a helper, not the boss

beats.vo: Let's play a matching game! Three helpers, and three people. A read-aloud app, an X-ray helper, and an animal counter. Who does each one help? Have a think.
beats.caption: Match each helper to who it helps

beats.vo: The read-aloud app helps someone who can't see well. The X-ray helper helps a doctor. And the animal counter helps a scientist. Well done!
beats.caption: Read-aloud · X-ray · Animal counter: matched!

beats.vo: True or false? Once scientists use AI, they don't need to check its work. Hmm. What do you think?
beats.caption: True or false? No need to check AI's work

beats.vo: False! AI can be wrong, so people always check.
beats.caption: False! People always check.

beats.vo: One more. True or false? AI is alive, and has its own ideas.
beats.caption: True or false? AI is alive

beats.vo: False again! AI is a helpful tool that learned from examples. People make the important choices.
beats.caption: False! AI is a tool. People choose.

beats.vo: Okay champ, here's a practice check, just like the quiz.
beats.caption: Your turn: practice check

beats.vo: Should AI choose your medicine, without a doctor? And why? Pause the video, and say your answer out loud, or write it on paper.
beats.caption: Should AI choose your medicine alone? Why?

beats.vo: No! AI can make mistakes. It can help, but a doctor must check, and decide. People stay in charge of important choices. Did you say something like that? Brilliant!
beats.caption: No! A doctor must check and decide.

beats.vo: Let's remember. AI helps spot plants, read aloud, and find routes.
beats.caption: AI helps spot, read, and find routes

beats.vo: AI helps doctors, scientists, and artists.
beats.caption: AI helps doctors, scientists, artists

beats.vo: AI is a tool. A helper, not the boss.
beats.caption: AI is a tool, not the boss

beats.vo: And people make the important choices.
beats.caption: People make the important choices

beats.vo: Chapter four, done! Just one more chapter to go, and it's a fun one. You'll imagine your very own AI helper!
beats.caption: Chapter 4 done!

beats.vo: Now let's see what you remember. Tap Finish, and try the quiz. You've got this!
beats.caption: Next: Quiz · Tap Finish
